rules: When an incoming software-development request requires evidence-grounded requirements, applicable prototype decisions, and explicit user approval before architecture design.
When review of a returned requirements result finds a concrete requirements-owned revision that must continue on the same delegated task lifecycle.
When the delegated Requirements Engineering Team result is complete or blocked and ready for department-level task-result review.
When the approved architecture-ready requirements package has passed department review and is ready for architecture, implementation, validation, and delivery.
When review of a returned software result finds a concrete software-owned revision that must continue on the same delegated task lifecycle.
When the delegated Software Engineering Team result is successfully finalized or blocked by a requirement gap and is ready for department-level task-result review.
